name: 40023 · Fisherville, KY
findings: ZIP 40023 (Fisherville) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40023 (Fisherville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
